defaults.language: preserve existing choice; follow system for a fresh install unless requested otherwise
defaults.optional_key_change: physical RED button; learn and confirm actual event code; never change the app default

device.stability_evidence: Owner reports stable operation. Fresh installation and two reboots recorded on 2026-10-25; second reboot verified both services before app launch. Named-player and long-duration playback unverified.

shizuku.name: shizuku-v13.7.0-thedjchi.apk

requirements: Wireless Debugging startup mode and successful pairing of Shizuku own key
Enable Start on boot in fork settings
Grant WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS if requested by installed fork setup
Actual reboot test: Shizuku running AND Screen Off TV service ready
non_root_boot.startup_delay: Shizuku may wait several minutes for Wi-Fi. Screen Off TV 0.1.3 keeps waiting and automatically retries failed service connections; the 30-second limit is per binding attempt, not total boot wait.
non_root_boot.pc_mode: PC-only startup does not provide automatic boot recovery

shizuku.root_boot: Only on a device already rooted; do not root as part of installation
shizuku.distribution: thedjchi/Shizuku TV-compatible fork; explicitly selected by project owner
shizuku.maintenance_status: Maintainer currently pauses maintenance; recheck release status before future updates

install_policy.existing_install_settings: Mandatory: record settings before updating, preserve them, then read back and compare language, key, gesture, display mode, both boot switches and TCP/Watchdog. Change only explicitly requested fields; never clear data or uninstall to bypass an update error.
install_policy.fresh_install_settings: use defaults; enable Shizuku boot startup only when supported by the startup method
install_policy.no_test_request: Skip only physical shortcut/screen/audio tests, reboot and automated tests. Still connect to TV, verify thedjchi fork, start Shizuku, authorize Screen Off TV, open settings and verify ready state.
install_policy.default_workflow: Complete BOTH applications: connect to the intended TV; download published APKs directly; verify thedjchi/Shizuku identity; install/start/configure Shizuku; install/authorize/start Screen Off TV; open settings and read back values; report completion only after every required item is observed.
install_policy.download_failure: Report the URL/download/checksum error; do not fall back to cloning or building.
install_policy.installed_shizuku_identity: Package name or icon is insufficient. Match installed base.apk SHA-256 to shizuku.sha256, or verify the signing certificate against shizuku.certificate_sha256 with existing tools. Report unverified/conflicting identity as incomplete.
install_policy.initial_state: Inspect each app separately: verified and running -> preserve and read settings; verified but stopped -> start and configure; missing or older -> download/install APK. Never reinstall merely to fix a stopped service.
install_policy.user_profile: Identify intended Android user and full per-user package UID for both apps. Match the Shizuku authorization entry to Screen Off TV package and UID; labels such as new_user (10) alone are insufficient. Do not grant all profiles.
install_policy.ui_navigation: Resolve launcher activity rather than guessing. Read current UI, tap preference row if its switch is not clickable, then refresh hierarchy after each UI-changing action. Never reuse stale bounds. During Shizuku pairing-code detection do not use UiAutomation/uiautomator dump; use remote/screenshots or request human pairing, then verify server PID and running UI. PC adb pair does not pair Shizuku itself.

required_installation_evidence.evidence: ADB device state, actual model and Android/API
Intended Android user ID, package IDs and full per-user installed UIDs for both apps; Shizuku authorization entry matched to Screen Off TV package/UID, not label alone.

Before/after versionCode for each app, selected APK source/hash when installed, and action taken (preserved/installed/updated). No downgrade, uninstall or data reset without explicit user instruction.
Installed APK SHA-256 or signing certificate proving thedjchi; installed version
Current Shizuku running UI and server PID

Read-back Start on boot and existing TCP/Watchdog values. Record supported/unsupported and startup method; unsupported may pass only when no requested boot requirement is left unmet. A boot switch alone is not a reboot test.
Installed version, Shizuku authorization and current Ready to control state
Read back all five fields: remote key, press action, boot switch, screen mode and language. Compare with pre-update baseline or fresh-install defaults.

For updates: before/after settings compared, with only user-requested changes. For fresh installs: explicitly record fresh install and verified defaults. If baseline cannot be read, report blocked rather than claim preservation.

completion_rule: Single source of truth: required_installation_evidence. Report every item by ID with current-run evidence. Overall ready only when every required item is passed and no requested configuration remains unmet; otherwise incomplete with missing step/reason. Historical verification is never current evidence. Report optional tests separately, including not_tested.

optional_verification.physical_key: Only when requested: actual remote input observed; ADB key events are insufficient.
optional_verification.screen_audio: Only when requested: real panel off/on and continuing audio observed with named player; ADB screenshots are insufficient.
optional_verification.reboot: Only when requested: verify boot completion, Shizuku PID and Screen Off TV service before manually opening either app, then confirm ready UI.
optional_verification.report: Report each as passed, failed or not_tested. Never infer test success from configured settings.

evidence_report.source: Current-run command output or current UI state; redact pairing codes and other secrets.
evidence_report.tests: Report optional_verification separately; ready means configured and ready, not physical/reboot tests passed.
